data.description: Modern Layout | Resort Amenities | Family Life
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this modern 2 Bedroom Apartment in FIA, Townsquare.

Features & Amenities

Modern architectural design with a warm and natural façade
High-quality interior finishes with built-in wardrobes and contemporary kitchens
Swimming pool with sun deck
Fully equipped gym and fitness facilities
Jogging and cycling tracks
Large green parks and landscaped community areas
Children’s playgrounds and family zones
BBQ and picnic areas
Sports courts for various activities
Yoga and wellness spaces
Clubhouse and community hall
Retail, dining, and convenience stores within the community
24/7 security and dedicated parking
Pet-friendly environment

FIA by Nshama is a stylish residential development located in the heart of Town Square, offering modern living surrounded by lush greenery and vibrant community spaces. Designed with contemporary architecture and warm natural tones, the project creates a calm and inviting environment perfect for families and professionals. The interiors feature elegant finishes, practical layouts, built-in storage, and well-designed kitchens that blend comfort with functionality. With direct access to parks, retail, and leisure facilities, FIA delivers a balanced lifestyle where nature meets urban convenience.
